newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka buys 25,000 T Indian, Vietnamese rice.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys 25,000 T Indian, Vietnamese rice.

text.p: Sri Lanka has bought 12,500 tonnes of Indian rice and 12,500 tonnes of Vietnamese rice for October delivery, the state buying arm Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (CWE) said on Monday.

"The Indian parboiled rice was bought at $250.40 per tonne c&f for arrival in the third week of October and the white raw rice of Vietnamese origin at $238.49 tonnes c&f for delivery in the fourth week of October," a CWE official said.
Sri Lanka earlier planned to buy 37,500 tonnes of Vietnamese rice but, "the purchase for the rest will be considered later," he said.
